note: Exact Edition 1.2 authority pins for every Tranche 2 component. This is the first tranche whose participant filings are official state forms, so unlike Tranche 1 every filing component here resolves to one retained Master Library asset by workflow key, document role, revision, language, canonical path and SHA-256. A component is pinned only where the retained asset is an approved packet candidate. No source-gated asset is pinned as a generation target, and no asset is selected by filename, folder scan or title similarity.

legalReviewAddendum.precedence: Controls the statements it lists and nothing else. Read before the retained review. adoptedMemorandum.controllingStatementForThisTranche: Priority issue resolution matrix / 12. Maryland — TRACK 6: official statewide shielding packet using CC-DC-CR-148 with MDJ-008 and current instructions; the narrow eligible-offense list, lifetime petition rule, and court-of-conviction venue are scope/routing fields, not reasons to deny packet identity.

tracks.acceptedStrategyBasis: Maryland Edition 1.2 controlling addendum, amended statement 1, on the authority of the adopted Batch 2 memorandum: md_second_chance_shielding is official_pdf_fill on CC-DC-CR-148 with MDJ-008.
scopeRestrictionsCarried: Hard-block every multi-court and multi-county record. Generate only where the participant has eligible convictions in exactly one court in exactly one county.
One shielding petition will be granted per lifetime. A participant who has already filed one is out of scope.
Never call this sealing or expungement. Say shielding.
tracks.venueAuthority: Md. Code, Crim. Proc. § 10-303, mirroring the § 10-105(b) structure: the court that entered the convictions for which shielding is sought. District Court of Maryland or circuit court, in one of the 23 counties or Baltimore City.

destination.name: Clerk of the District Court or circuit court that entered the convictions
destination.detail: In person, by mail, or through MDEC e-filing where the county is on MDEC. One court, one county.
